correctness.rationale: The graphical arrangement has full rank nine because the graph is connected. Its chambers correspond to acyclic orientations; a directed edge inequality is redundant exactly when there is an alternate directed path, and exactly the nonredundant inequalities label incident edges of the zonotope. The cover edges span a connected graph since each original arc refines to a path of covers. Nine covers therefore form a spanning tree. Its roots are a basis of the specified saturated lattice by deleting one incidence row and expanding at leaves; the dual chamber is smooth. More than nine facets means the full-dimensional cone is nonsimplicial, so the corresponding chart is not Q-factorial, in any characteristic. Independent replay uses a pentagon, spokes and pentagram, identifies the five stars and hence the Kneser labels, and excludes all 114 directed simple-circuit patterns from the 32768 orientation words. The surviving flip counts give (1080,2280,3600,3120,3120,2160,1320); their sum is 16680 and half their degree-weighted sum is 100080. Stabilizer counts give every cell of the stated orbit table (168 orbits). Of 2000 spanning trees, the 540 distinct nine-cover masks occur in one orbit of size 60 and four of size 120; every mask occurs for exactly two complementary words. This independently checks the two-orientation assertion without assuming it in the count.
residual_risks: The enumeration is exhaustive for the specified Petersen graph, not an assertion about other graphs or positive-dimensional singular strata.

value.rationale: Petersen is a canonical highly symmetric cubic graph and the valence spectrum measures all its toric fixed charts, not an arbitrary slice: degree nine detects precisely the smooth charts, and the orbit table distinguishes labeled counts from chart types under the natural graph action. The coherent spanning tree census gives a useful complementary classification. These exact refinements are not recoverable from the prior global face numbers alone and are a concrete benchmark for graphic arrangement and toric singularity studies.
residual_risks: Value rests on the local and symmetry refinements, not the recovery of totals or a claim to classify all singularities.
